title: Characterization of the crotonylation landscape in gastric cancer: a machine learning-derived prognostic signature and the oncogenic role of TIMP1.
summary: Single-cell analysis characterizes crotonylation patterns and links them to gastric-cancer phenotypes.
ai_technology: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) remains a lethal malignancy with high heterogeneity and poor prognosis. evidence.tested: Single-cell analysis characterizes crotonylation patterns and links them to gastric-cancer phenotypes.
evidence.unknown: The prognostic signature is based on existing cohorts; TIMP1 assays support a cell-level role but do not establish causal disease mechanisms or clinical utility in patients.
evidence.ai_role: The authors integrated single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data to derive and validate a machine-learning prognostic signature for crotonylation-related genes; separate cell experiments tested TIMP1’s role in gastric-cancer cell behavior.
